parameters.CALIBRATION_SET_RULE: held-out false alarms are counted per fault class on that class's scored sensor set: the spike path filter (dt.scored with the class's target and affected path) and the by-construction flags (bc_of with the class's target and fault kind, no-BC view as P4) applied per rule and direction exactly as in scoring; a fire that is not admitted mutes its sensor-rule until the next restart; the detector restarts after each counted alarm; the ledger keeps its BC catches (as in scoring); v2's all-sensors count is reported beside it, labelled
parameters.CLOCK_RULE_TEASTORE: the analysis monotonic clock is the journey ledger's (seconds from fixed_load's barrier); wall = mono + offset fitted on the ledger's startedAt/endedAt pairs (MARGIN_RULE's fit); the producer's offsets (intervention, probes; relative to receipt.window.measurementStartMonotonic) map to wall as measurementStartedAt + offset and then to the ledger clock by the fit; the largest deviation of the intervention's own wall/offset pairs from that mapping is the receipt-alignment residual, added to P1's tolerance; system samples are timed at their `monotonic` stamp (after the read) mapped the same way
parameters.EXPOSURE_RULE: route call path = services reachable from the entry over parent->child service edges of tokened, entry-rooted traces in the no-fault cells, plus `data store` services (project-map role rule) that a path service depends_on in the no-fault cells' compose-rendered.yml; exposed iff >= 1 ledger request started in [onset, hold end] and the sensor's service is on that path

KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.F10: OTel cell validity is the target-side receipt.json state (it folds in F1/G1/G2/G4, trace completeness and container health); the coordinator-side terminal replay (candidate_terminal.validate_campaign, remote-terminal.json) is not read. TeaStore reads the validator's candidate-validation.json.
KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.F11: The harness refuses a cell when one token maps to several Kieker traces, and (woven entry point) when one trace maps to several tokens (modules/teastore/witness/extract_native_token_correlation.py:449-467); the reader drops such bridge rows instead and counts them (readout: reader statistics, bridgeTokensWithSeveralTraces / bridgeTracesWithSeveralTokens). On harness-validated cells both counts are expected 0.
KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.F7: TeaStore fixture cells are written by the harness's test writer (tests/test_teastore_traffic_sweep.py make_sweep_run), which writes resources.json in every cell; the producer writes it in no-fault cells only (modules/teastore/execution/performance_campaign.py:1690-1693). The reader never reads M on TeaStore (FAMILY_CHANNELS), so the fixture difference is untested, not a reader path.
KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.F9: TeaStore S samples are placed on the wall clock through the producer's barrier pair (CLOCK_RULE_TEASTORE), not the ledger fit; the P4 margin of an S-vs-ledger lead omits that mapping term, which P1's tolerance includes (receipt-alignment residual). Immaterial at a 5 s cadence; recorded.
KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.G4: OTel: productcatalogservice logs through logrus's default TextFormatter (upstream src/productcatalogservice/main.go:57, not JSON) and frontend writes plain console output, so neither carries an app stamp the reader parses (JSON_LOG_STAMP_RULE notParsed): their L leads read "log lead not counted (no app stamp)" and their lines do not enter LOG_RECEIPT_RULE's bound. Recorded, not fixed (a logfmt reader would be a new layout).

parameters.LEDGER_ABSENT_TOKEN_RULE: the ledger's `absent` catch carries the token(s) of the first completion (any outcome) of the route after the silence; a sensor catch whose observation carries one of them is same-request (H3 c), no win; no completion after the silence -> no token
parameters.LOG_RECEIPT_RULE: per cell: max over log lines with both stamps of (Docker receive stamp - app stamp); Hotel app stamps are whole seconds, so the app stamp is the second boundary; a service whose lines carry no app stamp gets no bound and its log leads are not counted
parameters.MARGIN_RULE: granularity(ledger stamp) + granularity(sensor stamp) + clock-alignment residual (per-cell fit wall = monotonic + offset over the ledger's startedAt/actualStartMonotonic and endedAt/actualEndMonotonic pairs, max |residual|) + for logs the per-cell receipt-delay bound
parameters.P1_AMBIGUITY_WINDOW_RULE: pause: [fault-receipt startedMonotonic, Docker `pause` event of the target + delta]; delta = the cell's pre-onset median, over fault-free requests (ok, ended before startedMonotonic) whose trace has a span of the paused service, of (request end - the latest end of the paused service's spans in that request's trace), the span end mapped wall -> monotonic by the cell's fit; a request completing inside the window is ambiguous (it sets only the earliest expected timeout); no such request -> delta and P1 for the episode are —
parameters.P1_TOLERANCE_RULE: per episode: granularity(ledger stamp) + granularity(receipt stamp) + [pause: granularity(Docker event, 1e-9 s) + the cell's clock-alignment residual] + the cell's pre-onset median latency of successful requests

parameters.P4_NOT_EVALUABLE_RULE: P4 at a (class, rate) is — (not evaluable) when the ledger E or a collected sensor family (L, M, S, T) is not at the operating point there; highest_rate names every — rate as '— at {rates}'
parameters.PROBE_TRACE_RULE: TeaStore and OTel: an untokened trace rooted at the entry service whose root starts inside a stamped probe window (the receipt's probes and [revert issued, ready]) is probe traffic and is not read (the analogue of Hotel's token rule, v1 TOKEN_FILTER, which drops every untokened entry-rooted trace); other untokened traces (TeaStore's redirected home page, background work) are read and carry no token
parameters.RESOLUTION_RULE: min positive difference between two distinct values of one instrument inside one fault-free segment (one stream, one cell's fault-free time), minimum over the segments of the fit; for ledger latency (end - start of two float stamps) this is a float-difference granularity, not an instrument resolution, and never binding
parameters.ROUTE_GRAPH_RULE: the call graph for the spike path filter and the BC rules is the project map's (research/project-map/project_map.json callGraph, dt.call_graph), as for Hotel; for TeaStore and OTel its edges and on-route set are restricted to the system's ROUTE_SERVICES_<SYSTEM>, because their project-map base runs drove another route (TeaStore login-browse, OTel the home page with recommendations); Hotel's base run drove the sweep route, so Hotel is not restricted
parameters.SCALE_NOT_ESTIMABLE_RULE: a sensor (incl. a ledger route's latency) with >= MIN_BASELINE_POOLED pooled fault-free points and MAD = 0 in the fit used is 'scale not estimable': its level rules (spike, run3, median) give —, no catch and no false alarm, and it is listed; appear and absent are kept; no quantile threshold
parameters.SENSOR_ABSENT_TOKEN_RULE: a sensor's `absent` catch carries the token(s) of the observation that ends its silence (the stream's first record after the gap): its own token where it carries one (span: the token on the span itself, i.e. the tokened entry root; log: tokens named in the line), else the token(s) of the trace it belongs to (span: the trace's entry-root token, as the harness correlates it; log: the trace the line names, where the cell format carries one); if that request is the ledger's catching request the pair is same-request (H3 c, no win); with neither (no observation ends the silence, or the ending one carries no token and belongs to no tokened trace) the pair is unclassifiable: no win, counted and reported per rate
parameters.SILENCE_START_TOKEN_RULE: an `absent`-vs-`absent` pair (a sensor's `absent` against the ledger's `absent`) is same-request (H3 c, no win) if the silence-STARTING records share a request token OR the silence-ENDING records do (decision 57's test, unchanged). The starting record is the last observation before the silence on each channel: the ledger's last completion before its silence (its tokens), the sensor's last observation before its silence (its own token, else its trace's entry-root token, as decision 57). A pair with a token missing on either start, not already same-request, is unclassifiable (no win, counted). Mixed pairs (only one side `absent`) keep decision 57 / 51. Every absent-vs-absent lead is reported with its decomposition: (ledger's last completion - sensor's last observation, each from the onset in its own clock) + (g_ledger - g_sensor) + residual (clipping at the onset, a whole-second log stamp, a catch moved out of a probe window).
parameters.START_TERM_RULE: an `absent`-vs-`absent` pair that decisions 57 and 58 leave neither same-request nor unclassifiable (different requests start and end the two silences) is a win only if its START term (the ledger's last completion before its silence - the sensor's last observation before its silence, each from the onset in its own clock, i.e. on the common clock through the cell's alignment) exceeds the tie margin (MARGIN_RULE; on the availability clock its availability margin); the gap term (g_ledger - g_sensor) never counts toward a lead and stays printed in the decomposition; a pair whose start term cannot be computed is no win; category 'start term within the margin (decision 60)'. Mixed pairs (only one side `absent`) are unchanged.
